001package io.github.ai4ci.functions;
002
003import org.immutables.value.Value;
004
005import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeInfo;
006import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeName;
007import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonDeserialize;
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonSerialize;
009
010/**
011 * Gaussian kernel function.
012 *
013 * <p>
014 * This interface describes a simple Gaussian kernel function with parameters
015 * for the mean and standard deviation. It is used as a simple example of a
016 * kernel function and is not currently used in the model. Implementations are
017 * generated by Immutables (see {@link ImmutableGaussianKernel}).
018 *
019 * @author Rob Challen
020 */
021@Value.Immutable
022@JsonSerialize(as = ImmutableGaussianKernel.class)
023@JsonDeserialize(as = ImmutableGaussianKernel.class)
024@JsonTypeInfo(use = JsonTypeInfo.Id.NAME)
025@JsonTypeName("gaussian")
026public interface GaussianKernel extends java.io.Serializable, KernelFunction {
027
028        /**
029         * Mean of the Gaussian kernel.
030         *
031         * @return mean
032         */
033        double getMu();
034
035        /**
036         * Standard deviation of the Gaussian kernel.
037         *
038         * @return standard deviation
039         */
040        double getSigma();
041
042        /**
043         * Compute the raw value of the Gaussian kernel at a given point.
044         *
045         * <p>
046         * The raw value is computed using the formula:
047         *
048         * <pre>
049         * K(t) = exp(-((t - mu) ^ 2) / (2 * sigma ^ 2))
050         * </pre>
051         *
052         * @param t input value
053         * @return raw kernel value at t
054         */
055        @Override
056        default double rawValue(int t) {
057                var deltat = this.getMu() - t;
058                return Math
059                        .exp(-((deltat * deltat) / (2 * this.getSigma() * this.getSigma())));
060        }
061
062}
